claim: CDH1 loss in ILC creates a DUAL PI3K hyperactivation axis: (1) direct p85/p110alpha liberation (Bahreini 2017); (2) IGF1R→PI3K/AKT (Elangovan 2022). Both converge on AKT→CDK2/Cyclin E→RB1-independent G1/S bypass→CDK4/6i resistance. Alpelisib overcomes both axes. Clinical urgency maximized: ALL four major PI3K/AKT inhibitor trials (SOLAR-1, BYLieve, CAPItello-291, INAVO120) lack ILC histology subgroup data — this is a class-level gap representing thousands of enrolled patients without ILC-specific analysis. INAVO120 (inavolisib+palbociclib+fulvestrant, NEJM 2024) is the highest-impact target for ILC sub-analysis — triplet directly tests PI3Ki+CDK4/6i rechallenge in CDK4/6i-resistant setting. YAP nuclear localization confirmed in human ILC tissue (PMID 23949920, n=237) via Reactome-confirmed CDH1→LATS→YAP axis (R-HSA-2028269), generating a separate but convergent therapeutic vulnerability (verteporfin/TEAD inhibition) addressable in combination with alpelisib.

clinical_relevance.note: INAVO120 (NEJM 2024) is the current standard of care in PIK3CA-mutated HR+/HER2- post-CDK4/6i. ILC subgroup analysis is immediately publishable. PALMARES-2 CDK4/6i inferiority signal for ILC maximizes urgency.
